vertebrae.extractors.keras
==========================

.. py:module:: vertebrae.extractors.keras

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Optional Keras module extractor for local user-supplied models.



Classes
-------

.. autoapisummary::

   vertebrae.extractors.keras.KerasExtractor


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: KerasExtractor(name, model, collate_fn = None, output_fn = None, call_method = 'call', call_kwargs = None, predict_kwargs = None, modality = 'unknown', extractor_type = 'custom_keras', recipe_data = None, allow_sparse = False, streaming_safe = True)

   Wrap a locally loaded Keras model as a feature extractor.

   :param name: User-facing extractor name.
   :param model: A locally loaded Keras model or compatible callable object.
   :param collate_fn: Callable that converts raw inputs into model inputs.
   :param output_fn: Optional callable that converts raw model output into embeddings.
   :param call_method: Whether to use ``model(...)`` or ``model.predict(...)``.
   :param call_kwargs: Extra keyword arguments passed when ``call_method="call"``.
   :param predict_kwargs: Extra keyword arguments passed when ``call_method="predict"``.
   :param modality: Input modality metadata.
   :param extractor_type: Extractor family metadata.
   :param recipe_data: Extra serializable metadata for reproducibility.
   :param allow_sparse: Whether sparse embedding outputs are accepted.
   :param streaming_safe: Whether independent batches can be embedded without full-context state.


   .. py:method:: fit(X, y = None)

      No-op fit for local Keras models.



   .. py:method:: transform(X)

      Apply the collate function, run the model, and validate embeddings.



   .. py:method:: fit_transform(X, y = None)

      Fit the extractor and transform inputs.



   .. py:method:: recipe()

      Return a serializable recipe for this extractor.
